text:
alina: FYI I opened a compact PR that adds a tiny TS + Python snippet showing batching + kv-prefetch + quant-selection for short-chat workloads. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899
marcus: link looks great. can we show the TS snippet using the sdk v2 client pattern? people copy-paste that often.
tanya: also please add one sentence about the tradeoff: higher quant -> lower mem but sometimes worse short-turn coherence.
alina: added both requests in a follow-up commit. TS uses `new OptClient()` pattern and shows `batchSize: 4` + `kvPrefetch: true`.
bryce: minor: the Python snippet sets `quant_profile='q2_x'` which is unusual; our recommender usually suggests `q3_k` for chat-seq<64. is this intentional?
alina: i chose q2_x because it's the smallest size and good for ultra-low mem demos. but i can change it to q3_k and note tradeoffs.
marcus: suggest wording: "q2_x for extreme memory-constrained demos; q3_k recommended for production short-chat." keeps it clear.
docs-bot: docs-lint: error: code-fence-language-missing in docs/optimize/toolkit/migrate.md:318
alina: good catch — i accidentally used generic fences. will set python/typescript.
bryce: another CI warning: anchor `#kv-prefetch-note` missing. we renamed that heading in the reference restructure.
tanya: solution: link to the canonical API page `/docs/sdk/reference/kv-prefetch` and add a short parenthetical noting older anchors redirect.
alina: done. updated link and added `(redirects from /legacy/kv)` note.
marcus: can we include a 1-liner CLI test so folks can quickly run it locally? tiny runnable examples reduce support tickets.
alina: added `redwood-opt run --profile q3_k --batch 4 --kv-prefetch` as a one-liner in a shell block.
ci-bot: preview-build: failed — broken link to `/docs/sdk/reference/optclient` (404)
bryce: that's a new page that hasn't been published yet. we should point to `/docs/sdk/reference` root for now and file a follow-up to add the direct OptClient anchor once live.
tanya: ack. add an inline TODO comment in the PR and create a small task in the docs board to add the reference anchor when the API page lands.
alina: created task DOCS-762 and added the TODO inline.
docs-bot: preview-build: success — deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4899--docs.redwood.ai
marcus: quick nit on phrasing: change "use batching to save cost" -> "use micro-batching to reduce per-token cost while monitoring tail latency". explicit and less prescriptive.
alina: updated phrasing.
bryce: LGTM from me, approving.
tanya: LGTM, approving.
marcus: approved. merging after CI green.
docs-bot: CI: running full checks...
docs-bot: CI: green. all checks passed.
alina: merged! will watch the feedback channel for any confusion between q2_x and q3_k choices. thanks all.
